name: Algorithmic Objective Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit polynomial/base-4 objective function with a mathematically equivalent iterative algorithm using running sums. Models that blindly translate the algorithm will attempt to evaluate all valid configurations to find the minimum metric and will TLE on large instances. Only models that mathematically analyze and simplify the iterative process will realize it reduces to a base-4 positional value, enabling the intended lexicographical early-exit search.
